title: [RPG Design Guides] Support Skills ①: Importance and Examples

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】補助技① 重要性と作品例
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Support Skills ①: Importance and Examples

blocks.source: 補助技とは『能力アップ』など、自分や仲間を支援する効果を持つ魔法や特技を指す。攻撃や回復とは異なり、直接的な効果は無いが、多くのＲＰＧで使用されている。また、装備品やスキルの中には、同様の効果（補助効果）が設定されている場合もある。
blocks.translation: Support skills refer to spells and Techs with effects that support oneself or allies, such as “Stat Boost.” Unlike attacks and healing, they do not have a direct effect, but they are used in many RPGs. Some equipment and skills may also have similar effects (support effects).

blocks.source: ここで扱う補助技は、敵に掛ける状態異常とは分けて考える。ＦＦシリーズの『バーサク』の様に、補助なのか異常なのか、分類が難しいものもあるが、基本的に味方に使う補助魔法であるとして述べる。異常魔法としてのバーサクは状態異常編で説明する予定。
blocks.translation: The support skills discussed here should be considered separately from status ailments inflicted on enemies. Some, such as “Berserk” in the Final Fantasy series, are difficult to classify as either support or ailments, but here I will discuss them basically as support spells used on allies. Berserk as an ailment spell will be explained in the status ailments section.

blocks.source: 補助技・補助効果の利点
blocks.translation: Advantages of Support Skills and Effects

blocks.source: 戦闘に変化を付ける事ができる。強力な補助技を覚えた時は嬉しい。
blocks.translation: They can add variety to battles. Learning a powerful support skill feels rewarding.

blocks.source: 味方・敵キャラクターの差別化ができる。
blocks.translation: They can distinguish between ally and enemy characters.

blocks.source: 装備やスキルに補助効果を付けることで、差別化できる。
blocks.translation: Equipment and skills can be differentiated by giving them support effects.

blocks.source: 戦闘を攻撃と回復による単なる数値のやり取りから脱却するには、補助技は欠かせない。状態異常と並んで、ＲＰＧを盛り上げるためには必要な要素と言えるだろう。
blocks.translation: Support skills are essential for moving battles beyond simple exchanges of numbers through attacks and healing. Along with status ailments, they can be considered a necessary element for making RPGs more exciting.

blocks.source: 市販ＲＰＧの例
blocks.translation: Examples from Commercial RPGs

blocks.source: 補助技は戦闘を面白くするのに重要だが、その扱いは非常に難しい。具体的にはいくつかの市販ＲＰＧの例を見てもらうと分かりやすいと思う。それぞれ一長一短と言ったところである。
blocks.translation: Support skills are important for making battles interesting, but they are extremely difficult to handle. I think it will be easier to understand by looking at some specific examples from commercial RPGs. Each has its own strengths and weaknesses.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト２
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest II

blocks.source: トヘロス等、戦闘外で使用されるものとパルプンテを除くと、『スクルト』が唯一の補助呪文として登場する。
blocks.translation: Excluding spells used outside of battle, such as Rubbleru, and Hocus-Pocus, “Kabuff” appears as the only support spell.

blocks.source: ＦＣ版での効果は「仲間全体の守備力を１／８上昇させる」というもの。後のシリーズ作品と比較すると、効果が小さく非常に使い辛い。重ね掛けすると１／２まで上昇するのが救いだが、この頃のＤＱはボス戦でも短期決戦が多く、使用機会は限られる。
blocks.translation: In the FC version, its effect is to “increase the defense of all allies by 1/8.” Compared with later games in the series, the effect is small and makes it extremely difficult to use. The fact that repeated casts can raise it to 1/2 is a saving grace, but battles in this era of DQ—including boss battles—were often short, so opportunities to use it were limited.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版では一転。効果が１／２まで大幅上昇。攻撃力が高い相手にはザコ・ボス共に有効。ラスボスがルカナン（全体の守備減少）を使用してくることもあって、それを打ち消すためにも必須となる。（確か２回まで重ね掛け可能だったはず。）
blocks.translation: The SFC version is a complete turnaround. The effect is greatly increased to 1/2. It is effective against both regular enemies and bosses with high attack power. Since the final boss also uses Kasap (reduces the entire party’s defense), Kabuff is essential for canceling it out. (I believe it could be cast up to two times.)

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト３
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest III

blocks.source: ＦＣ版の時点でスクルトの効果が１／２まで上昇している。しかも、重ね掛けによる守備力の上限は１０２３なので、物理攻撃主体の敵はほぼ無力化が可能。
blocks.translation: By the FC version, Kabuff’s effect had increased to 1/2. Moreover, since the maximum defense value from repeated casts is 1023, enemies focused on physical attacks can be almost completely neutralized.

blocks.source: 他にもピオリム、フバーハ、マホカンタ、バイキルト、モシャスといった補助呪文が初登場する。それぞれの利点・欠点を紹介する。
blocks.translation: Other support spells, such as Acceleratle, Insulatle, Magic Barrier, Oomph, and Transform, also make their first appearances. I will introduce the advantages and disadvantages of each.

blocks.source: ピオリム
blocks.translation: Acceleratle

blocks.source: 全体の素早さが上昇。回復役のキャラが敵より速く動きたい場合に有効。数ターンで終わるザコ戦では、ターンとMPを消費してまで使う価値は薄い。
blocks.translation: The entire party’s agility increases. It is effective when a healer needs to act faster than the enemies. In regular battles that end within a few turns, it is rarely worth spending a turn and MP to use.

blocks.source: フバーハ
blocks.translation: Insulatle

blocks.source: 全体に息攻撃のダメージを半減するバリアを張る。性質上、息攻撃を使う相手にしか使用する意味はないが、ザコ戦・ボス戦共に機会はそこそこ。
blocks.translation: It places a barrier over the entire party that halves damage from breath attacks. By its nature, it is only useful against enemies that use breath attacks, but there are a fair number of opportunities to use it in both regular and boss battles.

blocks.source: マホカンタ
blocks.translation: Magic Barrier

blocks.source: 呪文を反射する鏡を張る。対象は自分１人。呪文攻撃主体の敵に有効だが、回復呪文まで跳ね返してしまう。バラモス等、息攻撃を使用する相手に使うには苦しい。ラストダンジョンで手に入る賢者の石ならば、反射されずに回復できるが、活躍機会はバラモスブロス戦ぐらいかも。
blocks.translation: It creates a mirror that reflects spells. It targets only one person. It is effective against enemies that primarily use offensive spells, but it also reflects healing spells. This makes it difficult to use against enemies such as Baramos that use breath attacks. The Sage’s Stone obtained in the final dungeon can heal without being reflected, but perhaps its only real opportunity to shine is in the battle against Baramos Bomus.

blocks.source: バイキルト
blocks.translation: Oomph

blocks.source: たたかうのダメージを２倍にする。対象は１人だが、効果は極めて強力。ボス戦では、ラスボスを除いて使用が必須同然となる。
blocks.translation: It doubles the damage of “Fight.” It targets one person, but its effect is extremely powerful. In boss battles, using it becomes almost mandatory, except against the final boss.

blocks.source: モシャス
blocks.translation: Transform

blocks.source: 他の仲間に姿を変え、能力や使用呪文が同じになる。それなりに強力だが、習得レベルが３７と高いので、使用機会は限られる。特にラスボス戦では後述の理由で役に立たない。根本的な問題として、他のキャラクターに成りすますということは、元のキャラクターの個性を殺してしまうという事でもある。
blocks.translation: The caster takes the form of another ally and gains the same abilities and spells. It is fairly powerful, but the required learning level is as high as 37, so opportunities to use it are limited. It is especially useless in the final boss battle for the reason described below. More fundamentally, impersonating another character also means sacrificing the original character’s individuality.

blocks.source: 補助呪文を語る上で、忘れてはならないのが、それらを打ち消す『凍てつく波動』の存在。
blocks.translation: When discussing support spells, we must not forget the existence of “Disruptive Wave,” which cancels them out.

blocks.source: ＤＱ３のラスボスが使用するのが、シリーズ初登場である。
blocks.translation: The final boss of DQ III is the first enemy in the series to use it.

blocks.source: ラスボスはこの凍てつく波動を頻繁に使用するので、補助呪文は非常に使い辛い。ピオリム、マホカンタ、モシャスに付いては、使用する意味がほぼなくなる。スクルト、フバーハ、バイキルトに付いては、まだ使う意味はあるが、劇的な効果は望めない。
blocks.translation: The final boss uses Disruptive Wave frequently, making support spells extremely difficult to use. Acceleratle, Magic Barrier, and Transform become almost meaningless. Kabuff, Insulatle, and Oomph still have some value, but dramatic effects cannot be expected.

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト９
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest IX

blocks.source: ＤＱ５以降のシリーズ作品の中では、ボス戦闘は最も短期決戦型である。バイキルトとフォースという様に、複数の攻撃強化手段が存在する。強化した物理攻撃（主に隼斬り）が強力なのだが、反面に魔法使い（バイキルト係）や魔法戦士（フォース係）が補助役になってしまう傾向がある。
blocks.translation: Among the series games from DQ V onward, its boss battles are the most focused on short decisive fights. There are multiple ways to strengthen attacks, such as Oomph and Fource. Strengthened physical attacks—mainly Falcon Slash—are powerful, but this tends to turn the mage (the Oomph caster) and magic warrior (the Fource caster) into support roles.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー４
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy IV

blocks.source: 全体的に消費ＭＰが大きく、効果が小さく使いにくい。しかし、リフレク等の一部魔法は攻略上必須と言って良いほどの効果を発揮する。
blocks.translation: MP costs are generally high, while the effects are weak and difficult to use. However, some spells, such as Reflect, are so effective that they can be considered essential for making progress.

blocks.source: リフレク
blocks.translation: Reflect

blocks.source: 魔法を反射する。
blocks.translation: It reflects magic.

blocks.source: ボス戦では敵の強力な技を反射したり、逆に敵に掛けて回復・補助魔法を妨害したりといった使い道ができる。ただし、効果時間は短く消費ＭＰは高い。後の作品の様に効果が持続しているのかどうかが、パッと見で分からないという問題も。
blocks.translation: In boss battles, it can be used to reflect powerful enemy techniques or, conversely, cast on enemies to interfere with their healing and support spells. However, its duration is short and its MP cost is high. Another problem is that, unlike in later games, it is not immediately apparent whether the effect is still active.

blocks.source: バーサク
blocks.translation: Berserk

blocks.source: 勝手に『たたかう』を行い、ターゲットも選べない代わりにダメージが上昇する。
blocks.translation: The character automatically uses “Fight” and cannot choose a target, but deals increased damage in return.

blocks.source: 主人公のセシルは『たたかう』を選ぶ機会が多いので、バーサク状態にした方が有利な状況も多い。
blocks.translation: Since the protagonist Cecil often has opportunities to choose “Fight,” there are many situations in which putting him into Berserk status is advantageous.

blocks.source: ブリンク
blocks.translation: Blink

blocks.source: 分身を作り、敵の物理攻撃を２回必ず回避する。物理攻撃主体の敵に有効。特にカウンター攻撃が中心のベヒーモス相手には有利に戦える。
blocks.translation: It creates an illusion that guarantees dodging the enemy’s physical attacks twice. It is effective against enemies that primarily use physical attacks. In particular, it allows you to fight Behemoths, whose main strategy is counterattacks, on favorable terms.

blocks.source: プロテス、シェル、ヘイスト等の補助魔法の効果は低め。消費ＭＰが高い割に、重ね掛けしてやっとまともに使えるというレベル。おまけに最終的な使い手が攻撃役のセシル＆回復役のローザなので、わざわざこれらを使う機会は少ない。
blocks.translation: The effects of support spells such as Protect, Shell, and Haste are relatively weak. Despite their high MP costs, they are barely usable unless cast repeatedly. In addition, their eventual users are Cecil, the attacker, and Rosa, the healer, so there are few opportunities to go out of your way to use them.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー５
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy V

blocks.source: シリーズ屈指の補助技の多さ。
blocks.translation: It has one of the greatest selections of support skills in the series.

blocks.source: 白魔道士、時魔道士、召喚士、青魔道士、薬師、吟遊詩人などのジョブに数多くの補助技が存在する。うまく使えばゲームバランスを壊しかねない強力なものが多く、ごく低レベルでのクリアも可能。
blocks.translation: Numerous support skills exist among jobs such as White Mage, Time Mage, Summoner, Blue Mage, Chemist, and Bard. Many are powerful enough to potentially break the game balance when used effectively, making it possible to clear the game at an extremely low level.

blocks.source: ＦＦ４と比較すると、消費MPが大きく下がっていることも特徴。
blocks.translation: Another notable feature is that MP costs are much lower than in Final Fantasy IV.

blocks.source: プロテス：9->3
blocks.translation: Protect: 9->3
Shell: 10->5
Reflect: 30->15

blocks.source: ヘイスト：25->5
blocks.translation: Haste: 25->5

blocks.source: 以下は補助技の例。数が多すぎるので、ほんの一部のみ抜粋。
blocks.translation: The following are examples of support abilities. There are too many to list them all, so only a small selection is included.

blocks.source: プロテス、シェル
blocks.translation: Protect, Shell

blocks.source: それぞれ、物理攻撃半減、魔法攻撃半減の効果を持つ。
blocks.translation: They halve physical and magical damage, respectively.

blocks.source: 特にシェルの効果は強力で、ラスボスの最強技アルマゲストですら、半減する。
blocks.translation: Shell is particularly powerful, halving even the final boss's ultimate ability, Armageddon.

blocks.source: ヘイスト
blocks.translation: Haste

blocks.source: タイムゲージが溜まる速度が２倍になる。実際はコマンド入力によるタイムラグがあるため、行動回数が２倍に増えるというわけではないが、それでも非常に強力。全体版のヘイスガは、ほとんど全てのボス戦で使用しておけば間違いない。
blocks.translation: The Time Gauge fills twice as fast. In practice, the command-input delay means that the number of actions does not actually double, but it is still extremely powerful. There is no mistake in using Hastega, the version that affects the entire party, in almost every boss battle.

blocks.source: カーバンクル
blocks.translation: Carbuncle

blocks.source: 全体にリフレクの魔法を掛ける召喚魔法。その状態で味方全体に攻撃魔法を掛ければ、敵に一気に反射して大ダメージを与えることができる。また、戦闘中常にリフレク状態になるアクセサリ『リフレクトリング』も登場する。いずれも、ホワイトウインドなど、反射されない回復手段と組み合わせることが可能。
blocks.translation: A summon spell that casts Reflect on the entire party. If you then cast offensive magic on the entire party, it can be reflected at the enemies all at once, dealing heavy damage. An accessory called the Reflect Ring also appears, putting the wearer in a constant Reflect state during battle. Both can be combined with healing methods that are not reflected, such as White Wind.

blocks.source: ゴーレム
blocks.translation: Golem

blocks.source: 味方全体への物理攻撃を一定量（術者のレベル依存）防ぐことができる召喚魔法。物理攻撃主体のボス戦で非常に有効。
blocks.translation: A summon spell that can block a set amount of physical damage aimed at the entire party, depending on the caster's level. It is extremely effective in boss battles centered on physical attacks.

blocks.source: ＦＦ５の補助技はこれだけ強力なのだが、それでもザコ戦で使用されることは少ない。ザコ敵がシリーズ内でも弱めな上に、味方に強力な攻撃技が多く、補助技を使うまでもないからである。
blocks.translation: FF5's support abilities are this powerful, yet they are still rarely used in battles against regular enemies. Not only are the regular enemies relatively weak compared to those in other games in the series, but the party also has so many powerful offensive abilities that there is no need to use support abilities.

blocks.source: ロマンシングサガ２
blocks.translation: Romancing SaGa 2

blocks.source: 手強いボスが多いことで有名な作品。個性的かつ強力な補助術が多く、うまく使いこなせれば難易度が下がる。というか、補助術を使用しない場合はクリアが不可能に近い。
blocks.translation: A game famous for having many formidable bosses. It has many distinctive and powerful support spells, and mastering their use lowers the difficulty. In fact, clearing the game without using support spells is nearly impossible.

blocks.source: 中でも、クイックタイムはバランスブレイカー。ラスボスが異常に強いため、攻略情報がなかった当時は、これを使わずに倒すのは至難の業だった。
blocks.translation: Quick Time is the biggest balance breaker of them all. Because the final boss is extraordinarily powerful, defeating it without this spell was extremely difficult back when no strategy information was available.

blocks.source: 重要な術が異なる系統に分配されており、それぞれの術レベルを上げなければならない。何となくプレイしていると、手に入れられない術も多い。一部抜粋。
blocks.translation: Important spells are distributed among different schools, and you must raise the spell level of each one. Many spells cannot be obtained if you simply play without paying much attention. Here is a partial selection.

blocks.source: リヴァイヴァ
blocks.translation: Reviva

blocks.source: 事前に掛けておけば、HPが０になっても全快で復活する。FFにおけるリレイズ。
blocks.translation: If cast in advance, it revives you at full HP even after your HP reaches 0. It is the equivalent of Reraise in Final Fantasy.

blocks.source: 霧隠れ
blocks.translation: Mist Veil

blocks.source: 透明になって、敵の単体攻撃の対象にならない＋回避可能な攻撃は全て回避できるようになる。
blocks.translation: You become invisible, preventing you from being targeted by the enemy's single-target attacks, and you can evade all attacks that are normally evadable.

blocks.source: 自分が攻撃すると効果は消えるが、その時の攻撃は敵の回避・耐性を無視する。ここから、即死技を使えば、無効の相手以外を一撃で倒すこともできる。
blocks.translation: The effect disappears when you attack, but that attack ignores the enemy's evasion and resistances. From this state, using an instant-death ability can defeat any opponent in one hit except those that are immune.

blocks.source: クイックタイム
blocks.translation: Quick Time

blocks.source: 使用したターンは敵の行動を禁止する。加えて、次のターンからは先制して行動できるようになる。
blocks.translation: Enemies are prevented from acting during the turn it is used. In addition, starting from the next turn, you can act first.

blocks.source: これを使えばラスボスですら、行動させずにハメ殺す事ができる。消費ＪＰは３６と非常に高いので、普通は３～５回でJPが枯渇するはず。
blocks.translation: With this, you can even trap the final boss and kill it without letting it act. Its JP cost is extremely high at 36, so normally your JP should run out after three to five uses.

blocks.source: 金剛盾
blocks.translation: Diamond Shield

blocks.source: 敵の物理攻撃を高確率で防ぐ。多くのボス戦で有効。
blocks.translation: It has a high chance of blocking the enemy's physical attacks. It is effective in many boss battles.

blocks.source: ソードバリア
blocks.translation: Sword Barrier

blocks.source: 敵の斬撃攻撃を完全に防ぐ。多くのボス戦で有効で、中には完封できる相手もいる。
blocks.translation: It completely blocks the enemy's slashing attacks. It is effective in many boss battles, and some opponents can be shut down completely with it.

blocks.source: 金剛盾とは重複できないので、どちらかを選ぶ必要がある。
blocks.translation: It cannot stack with Diamond Shield, so you must choose one or the other.

blocks.source: シャドウサーバント
blocks.translation: Shadow Servant

blocks.source: 自分の攻撃を真似する影を生み出し、攻撃ダメージを２倍にする。敵の物理攻撃を一度だけ無効化するが、２倍効果も消える。
blocks.translation: It creates a shadow that mimics your attacks, doubling attack damage. It nullifies one physical attack from an enemy, but the doubling effect also disappears.

blocks.source: 光の壁
blocks.translation: Wall of Light

blocks.source: 使用したターンの間、味方全体に対して、ダメージを半減する壁を作る。さらに、ターン終了時に敵にダメージを与える。
blocks.translation: It creates a wall that halves damage to the entire party for the turn it is used. It also damages enemies at the end of the turn.

blocks.source: 俺の屍を超えてゆけ
blocks.translation: Over My Dead Body

blocks.source: 重ね掛け可能な補助術・道具が非常に強力。敵の物理攻撃はほぼ無効化できる。術攻撃に関しては、そこまで強力な対策はないが、攻撃力を強化すれば数ターンで決着を付ける事が可能。ラスボス戦ですら、最初の数ターンを凌いで、パーティを強化してしまえば、後は楽勝となる。戦闘自体は短期決戦型なので、勝ちの決まった戦いをダラダラやらされることは少ない。
blocks.translation: Support spells and items that can be stacked are extremely powerful. Enemy physical attacks can be almost completely nullified. There are no particularly powerful countermeasures against spell attacks, but strengthening your attack power allows you to settle battles within a few turns. Even in the final boss battle, if you withstand the first few turns and strengthen your party, the rest becomes an easy victory. Battles themselves are designed as short decisive engagements, so you rarely have to drag out a battle whose outcome has already been decided.

blocks.source: このゲームにおける術の習得条件は術を手に入れた状態で、能力が一定を越える事。剣士などの前衛職でも、習得が遅れるだけで全ての術を覚える事ができる。これが、補助術の強力さを増している。
blocks.translation: In this game, the condition for learning a spell is to have obtained the spell and to have abilities exceeding a certain level. Even front-line classes such as swordsmen can learn every spell; it only takes them longer to do so. This increases the power of support spells.

blocks.source: 実は同梱の分厚い説明書に、補助術を重ね掛けする有効性が記述されていたりする。ここまでくれば、補助術特化のゲームバランスとして、潔くて良いかもしれない。
blocks.translation: In fact, the thick instruction manual included with the game even describes the effectiveness of stacking support spells. At this point, perhaps it is commendably straightforward for a game balanced around specializing in support spells.

blocks.source: 陽炎
blocks.translation: Mirage

blocks.source: 全体の回避率を上昇させる。重ね掛けすることで、ほぼ物理攻撃を回避可能。ちなみに、このゲームはシンボルエンカウントだが、マップ上で使うと、敵シンボルが近寄ってこなくなる効果を発揮する。
blocks.translation: It raises the evasion rate of the entire party. By stacking it, you can evade almost all physical attacks. Incidentally, this game uses symbol encounters, but using it on the map also prevents enemy symbols from approaching.

blocks.source: 石猿
blocks.translation: Stone Ape

blocks.source: 全員の防御力を上昇させる。陽炎より即効性は劣るが安定性は上。
blocks.translation: It raises everyone's defense. It is less immediately effective than Mirage, but more reliable.

blocks.source: 梵ピン
blocks.translation: Bon-Pin

blocks.source: 全員の攻撃力を増加させる。何度か重ね掛けすれば、ラスボスですら数ターンで倒せる程の破壊力を得られる。
blocks.translation: It increases everyone's attack power. After stacking it several times, you can gain enough destructive power to defeat even the final boss within a few turns.

blocks.source: ポケモンシリーズ
blocks.translation: Pokémon Series

blocks.source: ゲームシステム上、１ＶＳ１での短期決戦が多く、「補助技を使う」か「攻める」かの駆け引きがうまく成立している。
blocks.translation: Because the game system features many short, one-on-one battles, the mind game between using a support ability and attacking works very well.

blocks.source: ただし、本編では回復アイテムが使い放題の仕様なので、最初の１体目など弱い相手の前で、ひたすら能力を強化し、その後、全ての相手を瞬殺するといった味気ない戦術を取れたりする。対人戦だとそこまでうまくいかないけれど。
blocks.translation: However, in the main story, recovery items can be used without limit, so you can employ the dull strategy of endlessly boosting your stats in front of a weak opponent, such as the first Pokémon, and then instantly defeating every opponent afterward. It does not work quite so well in battles against other players, though.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 様々な例を挙げてみたが、これらの例には色々な問題点が含まれている。長くなったので、そのまとめは次回の記事で行う。
blocks.translation: I have presented various examples, but these examples contain various problems. Since this has become a long article, I will summarize them in the next article.

parts.source: 補助技② 問題点と対策

lines.translation: [[LINK_1]]> Return to the RPG Design Guides Table of Contents[[/LINK_1]]

texts.補助技とは『能力アップ』など、自分や仲間を支援する効果を持つ魔法や特技を指す。攻: Support skills refer to spells and Techs with effects that support oneself or allies, such as “Stat Boost.” Unlike attacks and healing, they do not have a direct effect, but they are used in many RPGs. Some equipment and skills may also have similar effects (support effects).
texts.ここで扱う補助技は、敵に掛ける状態異常とは分けて考える。ＦＦシリーズの『バーサク: The support skills discussed here should be considered separately from status ailments inflicted on enemies. Some, such as “Berserk” in the Final Fantasy series, are difficult to classify as either support or ailments, but here I will discuss them basically as support spells used on allies. Berserk as an ailment spell will be explained in the status ailments section.
texts.補助技・補助効果の利点: Advantages of Support Skills and Effects
texts.戦闘に変化を付ける事ができる。強力な補助技を覚えた時は嬉しい。: They can add variety to battles. Learning a powerful support skill feels rewarding.
texts.味方・敵キャラクターの差別化ができる。: They can distinguish between ally and enemy characters.
texts.装備やスキルに補助効果を付けることで、差別化できる。: Equipment and skills can be differentiated by giving them support effects.
texts.戦闘を攻撃と回復による単なる数値のやり取りから脱却するには、補助技は欠かせない。: Support skills are essential for moving battles beyond simple exchanges of numbers through attacks and healing. Along with status ailments, they can be considered a necessary element for making RPGs more exciting.
texts.補助技は戦闘を面白くするのに重要だが、その扱いは非常に難しい。具体的にはいくつか: Support skills are important for making battles interesting, but they are extremely difficult to handle. I think it will be easier to understand by looking at some specific examples from commercial RPGs. Each has its own strengths and weaknesses.
texts.トヘロス等、戦闘外で使用されるものとパルプンテを除くと、『スクルト』が唯一の補助: Excluding spells used outside of battle, such as Rubbleru, and Hocus-Pocus, “Kabuff” appears as the only support spell.
texts.ＦＣ版での効果は「仲間全体の守備力を１／８上昇させる」というもの。後のシリーズ作: In the FC version, its effect is to “increase the defense of all allies by 1/8.” Compared with later games in the series, the effect is small and makes it extremely difficult to use. The fact that repeated casts can raise it to 1/2 is a saving grace, but battles in this era of DQ—including boss battles—were often short, so opportunities to use it were limited.
texts.ＳＦＣ版では一転。効果が１／２まで大幅上昇。攻撃力が高い相手にはザコ・ボス共に有: The SFC version is a complete turnaround. The effect is greatly increased to 1/2. It is effective against both regular enemies and bosses with high attack power. Since the final boss also uses Kasap (reduces the entire party’s defense), Kabuff is essential for canceling it out. (I believe it could be cast up to two times.)
texts.ＦＣ版の時点でスクルトの効果が１／２まで上昇している。しかも、重ね掛けによる守備: By the FC version, Kabuff’s effect had increased to 1/2. Moreover, since the maximum defense value from repeated casts is 1023, enemies focused on physical attacks can be almost completely neutralized.
texts.他にもピオリム、フバーハ、マホカンタ、バイキルト、モシャスといった補助呪文が初登: Other support spells, such as Acceleratle, Insulatle, Magic Barrier, Oomph, and Transform, also make their first appearances. I will introduce the advantages and disadvantages of each.
texts.全体の素早さが上昇。回復役のキャラが敵より速く動きたい場合に有効。数ターンで終わ: The entire party’s agility increases. It is effective when a healer needs to act faster than the enemies. In regular battles that end within a few turns, it is rarely worth spending a turn and MP to use.
texts.全体に息攻撃のダメージを半減するバリアを張る。性質上、息攻撃を使う相手にしか使用: It places a barrier over the entire party that halves damage from breath attacks. By its nature, it is only useful against enemies that use breath attacks, but there are a fair number of opportunities to use it in both regular and boss battles.
texts.呪文を反射する鏡を張る。対象は自分１人。呪文攻撃主体の敵に有効だが、回復呪文まで: It creates a mirror that reflects spells. It targets only one person. It is effective against enemies that primarily use offensive spells, but it also reflects healing spells. This makes it difficult to use against enemies such as Baramos that use breath attacks. The Sage’s Stone obtained in the final dungeon can heal without being reflected, but perhaps its only real opportunity to shine is in the battle against Baramos Bomus.
texts.たたかうのダメージを２倍にする。対象は１人だが、効果は極めて強力。ボス戦では、ラ: It doubles the damage of “Fight.” It targets one person, but its effect is extremely powerful. In boss battles, using it becomes almost mandatory, except against the final boss.
texts.他の仲間に姿を変え、能力や使用呪文が同じになる。それなりに強力だが、習得レベルが: The caster takes the form of another ally and gains the same abilities and spells. It is fairly powerful, but the required learning level is as high as 37, so opportunities to use it are limited. It is especially useless in the final boss battle for the reason described below. More fundamentally, impersonating another character also means sacrificing the original character’s individuality.
texts.補助呪文を語る上で、忘れてはならないのが、それらを打ち消す『凍てつく波動』の存在: When discussing support spells, we must not forget the existence of “Disruptive Wave,” which cancels them out.
texts.ＤＱ３のラスボスが使用するのが、シリーズ初登場である。: The final boss of DQ III is the first enemy in the series to use it.
texts.ラスボスはこの凍てつく波動を頻繁に使用するので、補助呪文は非常に使い辛い。ピオリ: The final boss uses Disruptive Wave frequently, making support spells extremely difficult to use. Acceleratle, Magic Barrier, and Transform become almost meaningless. Kabuff, Insulatle, and Oomph still have some value, but dramatic effects cannot be expected.
texts.ＤＱ５以降のシリーズ作品の中では、ボス戦闘は最も短期決戦型である。バイキルトとフ: Among the series games from DQ V onward, its boss battles are the most focused on short decisive fights. There are multiple ways to strengthen attacks, such as Oomph and Fource. Strengthened physical attacks—mainly Falcon Slash—are powerful, but this tends to turn the mage (the Oomph caster) and magic warrior (the Fource caster) into support roles.
texts.全体的に消費ＭＰが大きく、効果が小さく使いにくい。しかし、リフレク等の一部魔法は: MP costs are generally high, while the effects are weak and difficult to use. However, some spells, such as Reflect, are so effective that they can be considered essential for making progress.
texts.ボス戦では敵の強力な技を反射したり、逆に敵に掛けて回復・補助魔法を妨害したりとい: In boss battles, it can be used to reflect powerful enemy techniques or, conversely, cast on enemies to interfere with their healing and support spells. However, its duration is short and its MP cost is high. Another problem is that, unlike in later games, it is not immediately apparent whether the effect is still active.
texts.勝手に『たたかう』を行い、ターゲットも選べない代わりにダメージが上昇する。: The character automatically uses “Fight” and cannot choose a target, but deals increased damage in return.
texts.主人公のセシルは『たたかう』を選ぶ機会が多いので、バーサク状態にした方が有利な状: Since the protagonist Cecil often has opportunities to choose “Fight,” there are many situations in which putting him into Berserk status is advantageous.
texts.分身を作り、敵の物理攻撃を２回必ず回避する。物理攻撃主体の敵に有効。特にカウンタ: It creates an illusion that guarantees dodging the enemy’s physical attacks twice. It is effective against enemies that primarily use physical attacks. In particular, it allows you to fight Behemoths, whose main strategy is counterattacks, on favorable terms.
texts.プロテス、シェル、ヘイスト等の補助魔法の効果は低め。消費ＭＰが高い割に、重ね掛け: The effects of support spells such as Protect, Shell, and Haste are relatively weak. Despite their high MP costs, they are barely usable unless cast repeatedly. In addition, their eventual users are Cecil, the attacker, and Rosa, the healer, so there are few opportunities to go out of your way to use them.
texts.シリーズ屈指の補助技の多さ。: It has one of the greatest selections of support skills in the series.
texts.白魔道士、時魔道士、召喚士、青魔道士、薬師、吟遊詩人などのジョブに数多くの補助技: Numerous support skills exist among jobs such as White Mage, Time Mage, Summoner, Blue Mage, Chemist, and Bard. Many are powerful enough to potentially break the game balance when used effectively, making it possible to clear the game at an extremely low level.
texts.ＦＦ４と比較すると、消費MPが大きく下がっていることも特徴。: Another notable feature is that MP costs are much lower than in Final Fantasy IV.
texts.以下は補助技の例。数が多すぎるので、ほんの一部のみ抜粋。: The following are examples of support abilities. There are too many to list them all, so only a small selection is included.
texts.それぞれ、物理攻撃半減、魔法攻撃半減の効果を持つ。: They halve physical and magical damage, respectively.
texts.特にシェルの効果は強力で、ラスボスの最強技アルマゲストですら、半減する。: Shell is particularly powerful, halving even the final boss's ultimate ability, Armageddon.
texts.タイムゲージが溜まる速度が２倍になる。実際はコマンド入力によるタイムラグがあるた: The Time Gauge fills twice as fast. In practice, the command-input delay means that the number of actions does not actually double, but it is still extremely powerful. There is no mistake in using Hastega, the version that affects the entire party, in almost every boss battle.
texts.全体にリフレクの魔法を掛ける召喚魔法。その状態で味方全体に攻撃魔法を掛ければ、敵: A summon spell that casts Reflect on the entire party. If you then cast offensive magic on the entire party, it can be reflected at the enemies all at once, dealing heavy damage. An accessory called the Reflect Ring also appears, putting the wearer in a constant Reflect state during battle. Both can be combined with healing methods that are not reflected, such as White Wind.
texts.味方全体への物理攻撃を一定量（術者のレベル依存）防ぐことができる召喚魔法。物理攻: A summon spell that can block a set amount of physical damage aimed at the entire party, depending on the caster's level. It is extremely effective in boss battles centered on physical attacks.
texts.ＦＦ５の補助技はこれだけ強力なのだが、それでもザコ戦で使用されることは少ない。ザ: FF5's support abilities are this powerful, yet they are still rarely used in battles against regular enemies. Not only are the regular enemies relatively weak compared to those in other games in the series, but the party also has so many powerful offensive abilities that there is no need to use support abilities.
texts.手強いボスが多いことで有名な作品。個性的かつ強力な補助術が多く、うまく使いこなせ: A game famous for having many formidable bosses. It has many distinctive and powerful support spells, and mastering their use lowers the difficulty. In fact, clearing the game without using support spells is nearly impossible.
texts.中でも、クイックタイムはバランスブレイカー。ラスボスが異常に強いため、攻略情報が: Quick Time is the biggest balance breaker of them all. Because the final boss is extraordinarily powerful, defeating it without this spell was extremely difficult back when no strategy information was available.
texts.重要な術が異なる系統に分配されており、それぞれの術レベルを上げなければならない。: Important spells are distributed among different schools, and you must raise the spell level of each one. Many spells cannot be obtained if you simply play without paying much attention. Here is a partial selection.
texts.事前に掛けておけば、HPが０になっても全快で復活する。FFにおけるリレイズ。: If cast in advance, it revives you at full HP even after your HP reaches 0. It is the equivalent of Reraise in Final Fantasy.
texts.透明になって、敵の単体攻撃の対象にならない＋回避可能な攻撃は全て回避できるように: You become invisible, preventing you from being targeted by the enemy's single-target attacks, and you can evade all attacks that are normally evadable.
texts.自分が攻撃すると効果は消えるが、その時の攻撃は敵の回避・耐性を無視する。ここから: The effect disappears when you attack, but that attack ignores the enemy's evasion and resistances. From this state, using an instant-death ability can defeat any opponent in one hit except those that are immune.
texts.使用したターンは敵の行動を禁止する。加えて、次のターンからは先制して行動できるよ: Enemies are prevented from acting during the turn it is used. In addition, starting from the next turn, you can act first.
texts.これを使えばラスボスですら、行動させずにハメ殺す事ができる。消費ＪＰは３６と非常: With this, you can even trap the final boss and kill it without letting it act. Its JP cost is extremely high at 36, so normally your JP should run out after three to five uses.
texts.敵の物理攻撃を高確率で防ぐ。多くのボス戦で有効。: It has a high chance of blocking the enemy's physical attacks. It is effective in many boss battles.
texts.敵の斬撃攻撃を完全に防ぐ。多くのボス戦で有効で、中には完封できる相手もいる。: It completely blocks the enemy's slashing attacks. It is effective in many boss battles, and some opponents can be shut down completely with it.
texts.金剛盾とは重複できないので、どちらかを選ぶ必要がある。: It cannot stack with Diamond Shield, so you must choose one or the other.
texts.自分の攻撃を真似する影を生み出し、攻撃ダメージを２倍にする。敵の物理攻撃を一度だ: It creates a shadow that mimics your attacks, doubling attack damage. It nullifies one physical attack from an enemy, but the doubling effect also disappears.
texts.使用したターンの間、味方全体に対して、ダメージを半減する壁を作る。さらに、ターン: It creates a wall that halves damage to the entire party for the turn it is used. It also damages enemies at the end of the turn.
texts.重ね掛け可能な補助術・道具が非常に強力。敵の物理攻撃はほぼ無効化できる。術攻撃に: Support spells and items that can be stacked are extremely powerful. Enemy physical attacks can be almost completely nullified. There are no particularly powerful countermeasures against spell attacks, but strengthening your attack power allows you to settle battles within a few turns. Even in the final boss battle, if you withstand the first few turns and strengthen your party, the rest becomes an easy victory. Battles themselves are designed as short decisive engagements, so you rarely have to drag out a battle whose outcome has already been decided.
texts.このゲームにおける術の習得条件は術を手に入れた状態で、能力が一定を越える事。剣士: In this game, the condition for learning a spell is to have obtained the spell and to have abilities exceeding a certain level. Even front-line classes such as swordsmen can learn every spell; it only takes them longer to do so. This increases the power of support spells.
texts.実は同梱の分厚い説明書に、補助術を重ね掛けする有効性が記述されていたりする。ここ: In fact, the thick instruction manual included with the game even describes the effectiveness of stacking support spells. At this point, perhaps it is commendably straightforward for a game balanced around specializing in support spells.
texts.全体の回避率を上昇させる。重ね掛けすることで、ほぼ物理攻撃を回避可能。ちなみに、: It raises the evasion rate of the entire party. By stacking it, you can evade almost all physical attacks. Incidentally, this game uses symbol encounters, but using it on the map also prevents enemy symbols from approaching.
texts.全員の防御力を上昇させる。陽炎より即効性は劣るが安定性は上。: It raises everyone's defense. It is less immediately effective than Mirage, but more reliable.
texts.全員の攻撃力を増加させる。何度か重ね掛けすれば、ラスボスですら数ターンで倒せる程: It increases everyone's attack power. After stacking it several times, you can gain enough destructive power to defeat even the final boss within a few turns.
texts.ゲームシステム上、１ＶＳ１での短期決戦が多く、「補助技を使う」か「攻める」かの駆: Because the game system features many short, one-on-one battles, the mind game between using a support ability and attacking works very well.
texts.ただし、本編では回復アイテムが使い放題の仕様なので、最初の１体目など弱い相手の前: However, in the main story, recovery items can be used without limit, so you can employ the dull strategy of endlessly boosting your stats in front of a weak opponent, such as the first Pokémon, and then instantly defeating every opponent afterward. It does not work quite so well in battles against other players, though.
texts.様々な例を挙げてみたが、これらの例には色々な問題点が含まれている。長くなったので: I have presented various examples, but these examples contain various problems. Since this has become a long article, I will summarize them in the next article.
